item.title: New edition: Alpahari Grihatyagi — 3rd edition, 2026
item.description: Third edition of the beloved debut novella that inspired a generation. Miles from home, thousands gather to prepare for the IIT entrance examination — a story as relevant today as when first published in 2010.

item.title: Book: Kal Ki Baat : Madhyam
item.description: The fourth volume of the Kal Ki Baat series, structured around the note Madhyam — the note that holds the balance between height and depth, tension and resolution.

item.title: Book: Komal Gandhaar
item.description: Komal Gandhaar — a satire collection. A sharp and humorous gaze on the absurdities and ironies of contemporary society, in the tradition of the great Hindi satirists.

item.title: Book: Komal Rishabh
item.description: Komal Rishabh — short stories as tender and poignant as the flattened note in Indian classical music. A new work continuing the spirit and sensibility of the Kal Ki Baat series.

item.title: Book: Ritambhara
item.description: A garland of Upanishadic narratives — a bold retelling of the great stories from India's knowledge tradition in contemporary short story form, drawing on the author's deep engagement with the Upanishads. Reviewed by Acharya Radhavallabh Tripathi.

item.title: Book: Varnochchar Vidhan
item.description: An introductory text on Indian classical phonology — a profound discussion of Sanskrit phoneme articulation, their acoustic structure and linguistic significance, bridging ancient phonological science with modern understanding. Reviewed by Acharya Radhavallabh Tripathi.

item.title: Third Edition of Abhinav Cinema Now Available

item.description: The 'bad' poems of Rishyashring — a poetry collection that challenges conventional poetic expectations, viewing modern life through the eyes of a mythological figure in a tone that is irreverent, humorous and deeply felt.
